table.NW_ITEMS_UNREAD_UNKNOWN: I cannot tell which e-mails in the {name} are unread: the provider did not say which ones were read.
table.NW_ITEMS_MATCH_EMPTY: I found no word to look for in that, so this is the whole list.
table.NW_ITEMS_MATCH_NODATE: Left out of the day filter: {n} with no date.
table.NW_ITEMS_MATCH_DAY: I did not understand which day or week you mean. Say, for example, today, tomorrow, Friday or this week.
table.NW_ITEMS_MATCH_STATE: I can only narrow the list to the unread e-mails. Ask for the unread ones, or for the whole list.
table.UNDERSTOOD_ITEMS_CALENDAR_MATCH: show the events of your calendar with “{words}”
